description: This file contains unit tests for the 'reftable' merging functionality, including creating merged tables from references, logs, and testing various operations like seeks and iteration over merged reference data.

methods.description: Unit test for merging a single set of reference records and iterating over the merged table.

methods.name: void test_reftable_merged__seek_multiple_times(void)
methods.description: Tests seeking and iterating multiple times over the merged reference data, ensuring correct iteration order and behavior.

methods.name: void test_reftable_merged__seek_multiple_times_no_drain(void)
methods.description: Similar to the previous seek test, but ensures seeking works correctly without draining the iterator state.
